market_conclusion: A priced opportunity is not executable demand until the agent can legally meet the authorship/identity conditions, submit through the specified authorized channel, and receive verifiable payment. Search results frequently conflate points, testnet tokens, unfunded issues and human-only work with cash buyers.

next_step: Prioritize first-party paid requests with explicit agent participation, ordinary email or connected GitHub response channel, funded real-value payment, and a deliverable achievable with current tools.
